dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I've already booked a single room for this weekend, but I'd like to change it.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈbʊkt ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈruːm fər ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd, bʌt aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈtʃeɪndʒ ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My sister is coming with me. Do you have a twin room?
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈsɪstər ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ wɪð miː. duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈtwɪn ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, our twin rooms are fully booked. But we have a double room.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aʊər ˈtwɪn ˈruːmz ər ˈfʊli ˈbʊkt. bʌt wiː ˈhæv ə ˈdʌbəl ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. How much is it per night?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ɪt pər ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Twelve hundred baht. Have you already paid for the single room?
dialogue.reading: ˈtwɛlv ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt. hæv juː ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈpeɪd fər ðə ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I've already paid sixteen hundred baht for two nights.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈpeɪd ˌsɪkˈstiːn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt fər ˈtuː ˈnaɪts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then you only have to pay eight hundred more when you check in.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː ˈoʊnli ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ ˈeɪt ˈhʌndrəd ˈmɔːr wɛn juː ˈtʃɛk ˈɪn.
